# rappi-mcp-unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP for personal Rappi (Brazil default). Not Partners.

Install:
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial setup
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial auth --token <personal-token>
- npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial doctor

Stdio (never set RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS in the snippet):
{ "mcpServers": { "rappi": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "rappi-mcp-unofficial"] } } }

Default: read-only. Never pays.
Charge only if RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is enabled AND explicit_user_intent is true. Guest tokens cannot charge.
Redacts street, phone, email, last-four.

Read tools: rappi_search_stores, rappi_search_products, rappi_get_store, rappi_get_cart, rappi_list_addresses, rappi_list_orders, rappi_get_order, rappi_track_order, rappi_list_payment_methods.
Gated cart: rappi_add_to_cart, rappi_update_cart_item, rappi_clear_cart.
Gated pay: rappi_place_order, rappi_set_payment_method.

HTTP optional: loopback 127.0.0.1 + Origin allowlist. Tokens in ~/.rappi-mcp/tokens.json (0600), never in git/tarball.
